$schema-note: Dated + justified allowlist for the npm/JS supply-chain gate (scripts/audit-published.mjs, v4-P3). Mirrors the Trivy .trivyignore triage discipline: an accepted HIGH/CRITICAL advisory in the PUBLISHED (@getknext/{core,lib,db}) production closure is suppressed ONLY by an entry here, so the gate can never be silently neutered. Each entry MUST carry: `id` (a GHSA/advisory id), `justification` (why it's accepted — not exploitable in our usage, no fix available, etc.), and `added` (ISO date it was accepted). `expires` (ISO date) is optional; past its expiry the entry stops suppressing and the risk must be re-justified. Bump the dependency FIRST; allowlist only when there is no fix.

allow.justification: Same advisory and reasoning as the matching entry in precompile-closure-allowlist.json: decode-uri-component 0.2.2 reaches the published @getknext/lib production closure only via minio -> query-string 7.1.3, whose decode path (parse/parseUrl/extract) minio never calls (it uses only stringify). The fixed 0.5.1 is ESM-only and breaks query-string 7's require(); minio's latest still pins query-string ^7.1.3, and a local patch would not reach published consumers. Drop on the first minio/query-string release that pulls a fixed decode-uri-component.
